ERR_POWER_BAD_CHANNEL.hint: Choose a channel the device has.

ERR_POWER_ALERT_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Choose an alert this channel offers.

ERR_POWER_EXT_FEEDBACK.message: {id} uses an external divider: its output cannot be set in mV
ERR_POWER_EXT_FEEDBACK.hint: Set it in its own terms (the device page says how), not in mV.

ERR_POWER_NO_PROFILE.message: {id}: the source offers nothing at or below {voltage_mV} (lowest {lowest_mV})
ERR_POWER_NO_PROFILE.hint: Use a charger that offers this voltage, or ask for a higher one.
